title: In-process COMTRADE workstation and safer FAT evidence continuity
titleId: COMTRADE in-process dan kontinuitas evidence FAT yang lebih aman
summary: ARSAS 1.6.36 keeps COMTRADE analysis inside the ARSAS workstation with the field-accepted native analysis bridge, restores the rich disturbance-analysis surfaces, converges FAT and Live Monitor UX, and hardens FAT evidence capture and restart persistence.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.36 menjaga analisis COMTRADE tetap di dalam workstation ARSAS dengan native analysis bridge yang sudah diterima di field, memulihkan surface analisis gangguan yang lengkap, merapikan UX FAT dan Live Monitor, serta memperkuat capture dan persistence evidence FAT saat restart.
highlights: Fault Records opens COMTRADE in-process inside ARSAS; the external ArdIrec Qt desktop UI is not launched or packaged.
The field-accepted disturbance workstation restores Time Signals, Phasor, Harmonics, six-loop distance Locus, cursor measurements and recorded-value engineering semantics.
The FAT workspace now follows the same Engineering card/header language, while Live Monitor keeps title, bounded search and filters on one compact row.
FAT capture now requires a real initialized live IEC 61850 observation, preventing offline SCL placeholders from becoming commissioning evidence.
FAT evidence resumes across ordinary application restarts and harmless IED display-name changes using durable SCL or endpoint identity, while damaged state files are preserved non-destructively.
highlightsId: Fault Records membuka COMTRADE secara in-process di dalam ARSAS; UI desktop Qt ArdIrec eksternal tidak dijalankan maupun dipaketkan.
Workstation disturbance yang sudah diterima di field memulihkan Time Signals, Phasor, Harmonics, distance Locus enam loop, cursor measurement, dan semantics engineering untuk recorded value.
Workspace FAT kini memakai bahasa card/header yang sama dengan Engineering, sementara Live Monitor menempatkan title, bounded search, dan filter dalam satu baris yang ringkas.
Capture FAT sekarang mensyaratkan observasi IEC 61850 live yang benar-benar sudah terinisialisasi sehingga placeholder SCL offline tidak dapat menjadi commissioning evidence.

Evidence FAT dapat dilanjutkan setelah restart aplikasi biasa dan perubahan display name IED yang aman menggunakan identity SCL atau endpoint yang durable, sementara file state yang rusak tetap dipertahankan secara non-destruktif.
improvements: Official Windows packaging pins the native-only ArdIrec bridge and explicitly rejects ardirec.exe and Qt runtime files.
COMTRADE release validation exercises the managed bridge plus native cursor, phasor, harmonics and distance-locus capabilities before packaging.
FAT persistence no longer depends on ephemeral runtime DeviceId and keeps an already collision-safe evidence path stable across display-name changes.
The stable Windows release pipeline runs full application regressions, portable and installer smoke tests, SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM, provenance and GitHub attestations before publication.
improvementsId: Packaging Windows resmi mengunci native-only ArdIrec bridge dan secara eksplisit menolak ardirec.exe serta file runtime Qt.
Validasi release COMTRADE menguji managed bridge beserta capability native cursor, phasor, harmonics, dan distance-locus sebelum packaging.
Persistence FAT tidak lagi bergantung pada runtime DeviceId yang ephemeral dan mempertahankan path evidence yang sudah collision-safe ketika display name berubah.
Pipeline stable release Windows menjalankan regression test aplikasi lengkap, smoke test portable dan installer, checksum SHA-256, SPDX SBOM, provenance, serta GitHub attestation sebelum publikasi.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for vendor-specific values, report behavior and field network conditions that cannot be reproduced by CI.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk value vendor-specific, perilaku report, dan kondisi network lapangan yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai, serta visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
